Tour itinerary

  1. Stop 1Kandy viewpoint and Peradeniya

    Meet your tuk-tuk driver and visit the viewpoint and botanical gardens.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Stop 2Bahirawakanda and Asgiriya

    Visit the Big Buddha and Asgiriya Temple.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Stop 3Lunch and Hanthana tea

    Stop for local food and visit the Hanthana tea museum.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  4. Stop 4Temple of the Tooth

    Explore the temple before your return to your hotel or a preferred Kandy location.

    Find this stop on the map ↗

Trip details

Published inclusions

  • Full-day tuk-tuk and English-speaking guide
  • Lunch at Helabojun and tea tasting at Hanthana
  • Listed garden and Temple of the Tooth entries

Exclusions and optional costs

  • Drinks, snacks, tips and optional donations
